# MY PG - PG Management Software

> MY PG is India's leading PG (Paying Guest) management software, trusted by 5000+ PG owners across 25+ cities. The platform provides comprehensive automation for rent collection, tenant management, room occupancy tracking, expense management, and reporting.

## Website Structure

- / - Homepage with product overview, features, pricing, and testimonials
- /#pricing - Pricing plans (Free Trial, Premium ₹499/month, ₹3999/year)
- /#careers - Job openings including Sales Executive positions in Bangalore
- /#contact - Contact form and company information

## Key Information

### Product
- Name: MY PG (also known as ManageYourPG)
- Type: PG Management Software / Property Management App
- Platform: Android mobile app + Web dashboard
- Target Users: PG owners, landlords, property managers in India
- Rating: 4.8/5 stars from 5000+ users

### Features
- Automated rent collection with WhatsApp reminders
- Tenant management with digital KYC storage
- Room and bed management with occupancy tracking
- Expense tracking and categorization
- Multi-property management support
- Digital rent receipts generation
- CCTV camera integration
- Food and mess management
- Cleaning and maintenance scheduling
- Police verification and background screening
- Short stay and long stay options
- UPI, Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm integration

### Pricing
- Free Trial: 7 days, full access, no credit card required
- Premium Monthly: ₹499/month, unlimited features
- Premium Yearly: ₹3999/year (save 33%)

### Coverage
Available in 50+ cities across India:
Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Chennai, Hyderabad, Pune, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Lucknow, Chandigarh, Coimbatore, Vizag, Indore, Bhopal, Nagpur

### Languages Supported
English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi
